integrity: The standalone Python 3.10+ verifier exhaustively reconstructs the complex, checks all face incidences and acyclicity, and evaluates signed Lefschetz traces independently in two group parameterizations. Files are embedded with decoded-byte counts and SHA-256 hashes.
scientific_limitations: The integral homotopy result concerns only the finite three-cube capacity-two complex. Its complete symmetry character is rational; no integral lattice decomposition or assertion about larger cubes, general crowns, or shellability is made. Independent mathematical verification is outstanding.
title: Three five-spheres and irreducible octahedral symmetry for the cube two-matching complex
